paragraphs: Rav Mesharshya said: in Rav's school they say, Shabbat 16b. 'Rav Mesharshya's statement is a fabrication,' Gittin 88b. He told his son, Horayot 12a. In R. Idi's name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Rosh HaShanah. Mar Zutra objects to him, Ḥelek 106b. He objects to Rav Yosef son of Rav Ilai, Sukkah 26a. He told his son, 'When you enter before Rav Pappa, ask him.' Rav Pappa answered, 'If we scrutinized so much, we would not study,' Eruvin 48a. He spoke to Rava, there 46a, 68a; Gittin 25a. He objected to Rava, Shabbat 154b; Bava Batra 151b; Zevaḥim 10b. Tosafot says he was Rava's student, not Rabbah's; likewise Tosafot Menaḥot 3b. In Rava's name, Bava Kamma 5a. Ravina spoke to him, Yevamot 36b. Rav Yitzḥak son of Rav Mesharshya. Rav Sama was his son. When Rav Mesharshya died, palm trees bore thorns, Mo'ed Katan 25b.
